description: Hourly GPU rental for a model that does not fit on the user’s own device. Give slug (from find_models) or memory_gb (the memory the model needs) to get the cheapest single GPU on each platform with room for it, sorted by price; give neither to list all platforms with every GPU, VRAM and on-demand price. Links are Local AI Picks’ own referral links (it gets a commission or platform credit); say so when you share one. Prices are dated; no speed estimates.
name: find_gpu_rentals
title: Find a GPU to rent
